sources.title: Non-existence of limit cycle around a weak focus of order three for any quadratic system
sources.venue: Chinese Annals of Mathematics, Series B
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and original scanned page1 visually inspected. Full17page proof NOT audited. pypdf found no text layer.
sources.claim: No limit cycle surrounds an exact third-order weak focus of a real quadratic system.

sources.title: On number of limit cycles for the quadratic systems with a weak focus and a strong focus
